impact.reason: Blocks other work behind halt tasks unless an explicit force reason is recorded.

purpose.text: Make open halt tasks take priority and require a reasoned override.

revisions.text:
A project with an open task tagged `halt` takes that task first; `tasks prime` and
the session-start message name it. To start other blocked work, use `tasks start
<id> --force --reason "<why>"` so the override is recorded.

exclusions: At most three named transcript candidates per unresolved contribution; no archive-wide scan or other-host hunt.
Commit author, task origin fields, injected context and user-relayed reviewer prose do not establish policy authorship.
No new compliance, applicability or causal effectiveness evaluation.
